top_decile_definition: y_bind >= 90th percentile of the developability-qualified pool
zero_shot_definition: Spearman rho of a zero-shot affinity predictor's ranking of the 1N8Z HCDR3 pool against measured binding (AbBiBench); compare with spearman_rho_curves, not with AUBQC.

m5_warm_start.definition: m5_hybrid with Round 0 (q=5) chosen by the Virtual Lab cold-start prior instead of five matched random draws: qualified (y_dev >= tau_dev), liability-free, >=2 non-WT substitutions, and greedy maximin sequence diversity with anchor coverage.

cross_target.label: aayl49 ML (anti-lysozyme)
cross_target.generalizes_across: antigen target and mutation landscape (same architecture; protocol sized to the qualified pool)
